<fidel-skip-link>

Skip link. A "Skip to the lesson" link, hidden until it has keyboard focus, that moves focus to the lesson.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Keyboard, switch and screen-reader users, who would otherwise Tab through the whole header first.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። Press Tab into this example: the link appears when it has focus.

The example lesson starts here.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<body>
  <fidel-skip-link target="#lesson"></fidel-skip-link>
  …
  <div id="lesson">…</div>

Source: player/src/components/e/small-tags.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-skip-link>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
targetCSS selector#mainWhere focus goes (tabindex="-1" is added when needed).
labeltext"Skip to the lesson"The link text.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

None.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Hidden until focused. Enter moves focus to the target.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks: The first Tab stop, if you put it first in <body>.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
